question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A long wandering or voyage usually marked by many changes of fortune
solution:
The correct answer is: **Odyssey**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**odyssey**' means a long wandering or voyage marked by many changes of fortune. (भाग्य के कई परिवर्तनों से चिह्नित एक लंबी भटकन या यात्रा)
 
• It is often used to describe a journey that is full of adventures and challenges.
 
• The word is derived from the name of the Greek hero Odysseus, who went on a long journey filled with many obstacles.
 
• The word 'odyssey' can be used in both literal and figurative contexts to describe a journey or experience that is long and eventful.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ode **- A poem that praises or celebrates someone or something. (गीति-काव्य)
 
• **Pilgrimage **- A journey made to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion. (तीर्थगमन)
 
• **Trip **- A journey or excursion, often for pleasure or business. (भ्रमण फेरा)
